nodes.description: Private owner address of Ownable; set in constructor and mutated by renounceOwnership/transferOwnership.
Mapping of token balances; mutated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of allowances; mutated in _approve.
Total token supply; increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Public transfer cap enforced in _transfer and modified by setMaxTxAmount.
ScoobyDooInu constructor: mints 1000000000000000e18 tokens to _msgSender().
External transfer(address,uint256); forwards _msgSender() as sender to _transfer.
External transferFrom(address,address,uint256); calls _transfer then decrements allowance via _approve.
External approve(address,uint256); calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Internal _transfer: validates addresses, enforces maxTxAmount for non-owner, updates balances.
Internal _mint: creates tokens and increases total supply.
Internal _burn: destroys tokens and decreases total supply.
Internal _approve: writes the _allowances mapping and emits Approval.
External onlyOwner setter for maxTxAmount with a lower bound check.
External helper that adds to the caller's allowance for a spender.
External helper that subtracts from the caller's allowance for a spender.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a new non-zero address.
Public view returning the _owner state variable.
Context._msgSender() returns msg.sender.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller identity used for authorization and authorization bypass analysis.
Subtraction of amount from _balances[sender] in _transfer (SafeMath protected).
Addition of amount to _balances[recipient] in _transfer.
Owner-gated write of the maxTxAmount state variable in setMaxTxAmount.
Write of the _allowances mapping in _approve.
Write of the _owner state variable in renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Increase of _totalSupply inside _mint.
recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
amount uint256 parameter flowing into balance arithmetic.
spender address parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
sender address parameter of the public transferFrom entry point.
account address parameter of _mint/_burn.
New cap value parameter of setMaxTxAmount.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Value added to allowance in increaseAllowance.
Value subtracted from allowance in decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: _msgSender() directly returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the caller derived from msg.sender.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the token sender.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as spender when decreasing allowance, so caller identity governs authorization.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
msg.sender propagates into _transfer as the sender argument.
transfer() invokes _transfer.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer.
transferFrom() invokes _approve to update the remaining allowance.
approve() invokes _approve.
increaseAllowance() computes an addition before calling _approve.
decreaseAllowance() computes a subtraction before calling _approve.
_transfer performs the balance subtraction for the sender.
_transfer performs the balance addition for the recipient.
Result of the sender balance subtraction is written into _balances.
Result of the recipient balance addition is written into _balances.
Constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
_mint increases the total supply.
Mint operation writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve performs the allowance state write.
Allowance write targets the _allowances mapping.
setMaxTxAmount, gated by onlyOwner, writes maxTxAmount.
Owner-only write of the maxTxAmount state variable.
Caller-supplied cap value parameter is stored by setMaxTxAmount.
transferOwnership, gated by onlyOwner, writes the owner variable.
renounceOwnership, gated by onlyOwner, writes the owner variable.
Owner write operations update the _owner state variable.
owner() reads the privileged _owner state variable.
maxTxAmount is read in _transfer to gate non-owner transfers.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into the balance arithmetic of _transfer.
spender parameter flows into approve/_approve.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom/_transfer.
account parameter flows into _mint.
newOwner parameter is written to _owner by transferOwnership.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances before subtracting.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a transient argument of _transfer and carries no independent authorization meaning.
amount is consumed by the balance subtraction/addition arithmetic in _transfer.
spender only parameterizes the approve/_approve allowance update.
sender is only a transient argument of the public transferFrom entry point.
account only parameterizes the minted balance assignment.
the new cap value is stored directly into the maxTxAmount state variable.
newOwner is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
addedValue exists solely to compute the increased allowance.
subtractedValue exists solely to compute the decreased allowance.
